body.objective: Promote the Schwartz detector's pointwise pair-versus-number spectral gap to an operator bound for every undesired quadratic sector at first Dyson order on a compact one-particle energy domain.
activates: an explicit finite bidifferential off-shell density matching the fixed-P filter
a Hilbert-Schmidt number-scattering operator on a compact energy band
a global wrong-sign pair-vector norm bound
a complete first-Dyson quadratic-sector perturbation bound relative to the desired pair absorption
body.current_gate: Use D_F=:F((i partial_1-i partial_2)/M0)phi(x1)phi(x2): at x1=x2. On K={M0/4<=|k|<=3M0/4}, bound the number symbol by A0(3/2)^38 and use dist(P0,{q^2<=0})^2=M0^2/2. Compare its Hilbert-Schmidt norm with the desired pair norm from the unit Gaussian four-ball. Bound the wrong-sign pair vector by a Gaussian tail outside R=1/sigma_over_M0.
body.stop_condition: Land a COEFFICIENT_COMPUTED exact certificate, independent verifier, mutations and report showing each undesired first-Dyson quadratic block has squared norm relative to the desired pair block below 10^-1000000, and that the induced leading click effect changes by less than 10^-399999 on the declared domain.
body.forbid: no rewrite of the published Schwartz V1 certificate; no claim outside the compact one-particle energy band; no promotion from first Dyson order to complete time ordering, all-order unitarity, absolute q8, Eq. 19, gravity, QME or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL physics
body.resource_hint: With dmu=d3k/(2|k|), mu(K)=pi M0^2/2. The desired symmetric pair norm is at least t*pi^3*sigma^4*(1-2/e)/8 with rational t>1/64. The number squared ratio has a prefactor below 2^153 multiplying exp[-1/(2s^2)]. The wrong-sign pair squared ratio has a prefactor below 2^47 multiplying exp[-(1/s^2-76)].
